items.title: Star Casino enters trading halt as it responds to $260m money laundering fine

children.content: Star Entertainment Group went into a trading halt this morning as it responded to news of a $260 million fine for turning a blind eye to money laundering at its Sydney casino. It says it will not fold, despite a penalty more than double the figure its lawyers contended could sent it into liquidation.
